body:
Reviewed PR #7 (codex/rheos-dependency-admission-plan → main, head 5d0348c) end to end: all 14 full-diff pages delivered and assessed; the change is planning-only — 16 files comprising append-only journals (.ημ/receipts.edn, session-mycology/ledger.md, docs/agile/.events/ledger.edn), seven evidence-JSON transcriptions, and amendments to the relationship epic/writer/parity tasks plus the uuid-relationship-authoring plan note, with the contract task moving review→done. No source, test, workflow, package, or runtime bytes changed.

Deterministic evidence: all 10 gates green at the exact head on a clean checkout (git diff --check clean; 220 tests / 2043 assertions / 0 failures twice; lint 0 errors/0 warnings; 4 release builds 0 warnings). Green gates are tool evidence only; the verdict below rests on independent source verification.

Confirmed findings: none. Every checkable claim was adversarially verified against the working tree: (1) the plan's four source diagnoses are accurate — task_store's load path drops :dependency/:parent/:epic/:type, domain/transition's decide-move is dependency-blind, infra/transition's move-task! has no post-gate revalidation or inter-process reservation, and promethean-fsm's ready/todo admission edges are :always-allow; (2) the contract card's Review→Document→Done transition is a lawful FSM chain, and its write-id, status, and appended comment text match the committed ledger events exactly; (3) journal prefixes are preserved (all 6 deletions are intentional planning-prose rewrites); (4) writer/parity/epic frontmatter (Incoming, 5/5/13, UUIDs) is untouched, matching the PR body; (5) embedded historical APPROVED verdicts are commit-bound to the already-merged PR1 head, change no gate, and explicitly do not transfer.

Non-blocking notes: the provisional 5/5 estimates and the proposed done→ready/todo/in_progress admission policy are correctly left for the author's own fresh-planning review before RED, as the cards state; external foresight milestone/epic links referenced by the body were not staged and are not independently verifiable here; evidence-JSON historical hashes (PR1 merge tree, 87-page review counts) are unverifiable from this repo but behaviorally inert and epistemic-tier-labeled. Approve.
